import pytest
from string_utils import mask_email


def test_mask_email_single_char_local():
    """Test that single-character local part is returned unchanged."""
    assert mask_email("a@example.com") == "a@example.com"


def test_mask_email_long_local():
    """Test that long local part is masked with stars."""
    assert mask_email("jsmith@example.com") == "j*****@example.com"


def test_mask_email_empty_local_raises():
    """Test that empty local part raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: empty local part or domain"):
        mask_email("@example.com")


def test_mask_email_empty_domain_raises():
    """Test that empty domain raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: empty local part or domain"):
        mask_email("user@")


def test_mask_email_no_at_raises():
    """Test that missing '@' raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: missing '@'"):
        mask_email("userexample.com")

import pytest
from string_utils import mask_email


def test_mask_email_local_one_char_returns_unmasked():
    """Test that local part of length 1 returns unmasked."""
    assert mask_email("a@domain.com") == "a@domain.com"


def test_mask_email_local_two_chars_returns_masked():
    """Test that local part of length 2 returns masked with one star."""
    assert mask_email("ab@domain.com") == "a*@domain.com"


def test_mask_email_local_three_chars_returns_masked():
    """Test that local part of length 3 returns masked with two stars."""
    assert mask_email("abc@domain.com") == "a**@domain.com"


def test_mask_email_domain_empty_raises():
    """Test that domain empty raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: empty local part or domain"):
        mask_email("user@")

import pytest
from validators import validate_username


def test_username_length_boundary_min():
    """Test that username of exactly 3 characters passes validation."""
    result = validate_username("abc")
    assert result == "abc"


def test_username_length_boundary_max():
    """Test that username of exactly 16 characters passes validation."""
    result = validate_username("a" * 16)
    assert result == "a" * 16


def test_username_too_short():
    """Test that username shorter than 3 characters raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="length must be 3..16"):
        validate_username("ab")


def test_username_too_long():
    """Test that username longer than 16 characters raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="length must be 3..16"):
        validate_username("a" * 17)

import pytest
from validators import validate_username


def test_username_starts_with_letter():
    """Test that username starting with a letter passes validation."""
    result = validate_username("abc")
    assert result == "abc"


def test_username_starts_with_digit():
    """Test that username starting with a digit raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must start with a letter"):
        validate_username("1abc")


def test_username_starts_with_underscore():
    """Test that username starting with underscore raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must start with a letter"):
        validate_username("_abc")


def test_username_starts_with_special_char():
    """Test that username starting with special character raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must start with a letter"):
        validate_username("!abc")
